label: Demucs stem laboratory
summary: Optional reversible stem-separation lane for bass, drums, vocals, guitar, and other-part repair experiments.

handoffs.label: Separate tentative stems
handoffs.intent: Create editable repair candidates from a checksummed parent mix while preserving bleed and model artifacts as evidence.
inputs: A checksummed parent mix and requested repair question
Exact Demucs model, device, and output directory outside the parent
outputs: Common-start lossless tentative stems and reconstruction note
steps: Separate only for a declared question
Audition stems together and against the parent before editing
verification: Check alignment, duration, bleed, artifacts, reconstruction behavior, and checksums
Keep the parent as the release reference until a new mix is approved

preserve: Parent mix, stems, model/version, separation settings, and artifact notes
avoid: Destructive stem replacement, claims of clean isolation, and silent normalization or limiting
